verdict.gold_reason: Article 14(8) states that if the relevant Member States fail to reach a unanimous decision on amending the bidding zone configuration, the Commission, after consulting ACER, adopts the decision as a last resort. Article 15(5) says the same for the case where a TSO has not met the linear trajectory, though it adds consultation of relevant stakeholders.

other_articles.why: Describes the review of bidding zone configuration and says Member States or regulatory authorities reach an agreement, but names no last-resort decision-maker.
